message:
The other night, I found myself in the middle of a blackout. I’d just settled down with a cup of tea when—poof! My cozy glow vanished, and I was plunged into darkness. I fumbled around for my flashlight, only to realize it was buried under a pile of old magazines. After a comical scavenger hunt, I finally located it, only to discover the batteries were dead. 

I ended up using my phone’s flashlight while I dug out power banks and wrangled my snacks into a cooler before everything warmed up. It was a little chaotic, but I had to laugh at myself! Now, I’ve made it a priority to keep a dedicated “power outage kit” handy. 

What’s your best tip for staying cozy and prepared during an unexpected blackout? 😊
